Class GameContext

java.lang.Object
simscli.game.GameContext
All Implemented Interfaces:
ActionUIAdapter
public final class GameContext extends Object implements ActionUIAdapter
Game context adapter providing actions with UI and game state access. Implements ActionUIAdapter for dependency injection.
